items.name: Band of Light Ring
items.function: Can summon blinding light and use several spells in the Sun domain.
items.downside: The user will slowly become a believer of the Eternal Blazing Sun.

items.name: Building Blocks
items.appearance: A collection of brightly colored blocks.
items.function: Able to establish a connection with the real building.
items.downside: Without external help, it was almost impossible for people or items inside to leave.

items.name: Moonlight Sash
items.function: It can effectively reduce Sun and Lightning damage.
items.downside:
The user senses become more acute, able to easily see things that shouldn't be seen, hear the sounds they shouldn't hear.
The wearer will feel itchy intermittently.

items.name: Oath of Rose
items.appearance: A pair of silvery-white rings with a sapphire gem embedded in it.
items.function: Allows both wearer to share their senses and transmit their thoughts to each other.
items.downside:
It occasionally lets the user's thoughts appear in the mind of the counterpart.
If it is worn for a week without being taken off, both people who wore the ring have a great chance to fall in love, regardless of their gender and race.

items.name: Rever's Shout of Despair
items.appearance: A big gray revolver with six big barrels.
items.function:
Mental at attack every shot.
Infinite ammunition.
Machine gun mode.
items.downside: The user would also hear the shout of despair, from time to time.

items.name: Specter Portrait Frame
items.function: Seals the soul of whoever looks at it.
items.downside: Can seal the users soul if not careful.

items.name: Trumpet Telegraph
items.appearance: A golden, palm-sized telegraph with a trumpet attached to it.
items.function: It allows the user's voice to sound out simultaneously up to a radius of 5 kilometers.
items.downside: All sounds within 5 kilometers will be transmitted to the user's ears for an extended period of time.
